week.label: Week 1 of 4
week.rule: Every set stops 3 reps short of failure.
week.ruleWhy: The cost of going too hard in week 1 isn't soreness — it's the session you skip in week 2.

sessions.name: Strength A — full body
sessions.summary: Session 1 of 4. Squat, hinge, push and pull in one go.

items.label: Warm-up
items.detail: Goblet squat x10 light · band pull-apart x15 · hip hinge x10 · arm circles x20 each way.

items.load: A weight you could do 13 with

items.label: Cool-down
items.detail: Quad, hamstring and chest stretch, 30 s each.

sessions.name: Easy run — 3 km
sessions.summary: Session 2 of 4. The only run this week — and that's deliberate.

items.label: Brisk walk
items.detail: An actual warm-up, not a formality.

items.label: Easy run
items.detail: Conversational pace. If you can't talk, walk for 60 seconds. Finish feeling you could comfortably do another kilometre.

items.label: Walk + stretch
items.detail: Calves, hip flexors, hamstrings.

items.label: Why only one run
items.detail: Your aerobic base can handle more, but after three months off your tendons can't. Cycling carries the cardio volume instead. Running goes to 2x in week 3.

sessions.name: Mobility + walk
sessions.summary: The session people skip. Don't — it's what makes Thursday possible.

items.label: Walk
items.detail: Easy, outdoors if you can. Counts toward the 8,000 steps.

sessions.name: Strength B — full body
sessions.summary: Session 3 of 4. Different exercises, same four patterns.

items.label: Warm-up
items.detail: Goblet squat x10 light · band pull-apart x15 · hip hinge x10 · arm circles x20 each way.

items.label: Cool-down
items.detail: Hip flexors, lats, calves.

sessions.name: Cycle — Zone 2
sessions.summary: Session 4 of 4. This completes the week.

items.label: Spin easy
items.detail: Build in gradually, no hard start.

items.label: Steady Zone 2
items.detail: Cadence 80-90, nose-breathing pace. You should be able to hold a conversation the whole way. If you can't, you're going too hard — which defeats the point of the session.

items.label: Spin down
items.detail: Legs loose, breathing back to normal.

sessions.name: Long easy — cycle or hike
sessions.summary: Optional 5th session. Skipping it still leaves a complete week.

items.label: ⚠️ Train to Secunderabad leaves KSR at 20:00
items.detail: Do this in the morning or early afternoon, not the evening. A long easy session is a good call before an overnight train — it helps you sleep in a berth. A hard one would do the opposite.

items.label: Cycle or hike
items.detail: Easy throughout. Pick whichever you'll actually enjoy — that's the selection criterion this week. NOT a second run.

items.label: Log it twice
items.detail: Counts for Happiness as well as Health — outdoor hours go in Weekly Log column Q.

sessions.name: Rest + weekly review
sessions.summary: The 15 minutes that make the whole system work.

items.label: You arrive at 07:00
items.detail: After a night in a berth, so today is a genuine rest day. Log your sleep honestly — a bad night on a train is data, not a failure.

items.label: Fill the Weekly Log
items.detail: Row w/c 26-Oct: column D = 4 (or 5 with Saturday), column E = 2. That is a COMPLETE week, not a shortfall — the ramp reaches 5 sessions in week 3.

items.label: Next week's card
items.detail: Three commitments on a fresh A5 card.

items.label: Journal page
items.detail: What worked, what didn't, one gratitude.

items.label: Week 2 (w/c 2 Nov)
items.detail: Same exercises, but add one set to the first two lifts in each strength session, and take the run to 3.5 km.
